claims.statement: The literal weighted Hall graph has an integer flow saturating all positive upper-layer supply on each of the first five stored eligible rank-7 census rows at each order 16, 17, and 18.
claims.scope: Exactly 15 rows: the first five eligible rows in stored order from the supplied order-16, order-17, and order-18 p=7 results. For each tree, F is its original strict favorable selector; upper/lower layers are independent sets of sizes 8/7; arcs are all one-vertex deletions and the specified absent-vertex switches with exactly two neighbors in the upper set. This is a finite feasibility result only.
claims.reason: Exact integer max-flow certificates were computed and checked for legal arcs, node capacities, conservation, and saturation on these 15 literal-set graphs. The 4,976 other eligible p=7 rows and all larger cases are untested, so this bounded sample does not establish the weighted Hall mechanism or decide the primary universal aggregate.

limitations: The flow sample is the deterministic first-five prefix at each order, not a random or representative sample.
Only 15 of the supplied 4,991 eligible p=7 rows were flow-tested; the remaining 4,976 rows and all larger cases remain untested.
Feasible flows certify the mechanism only on the tested graphs and do not establish a universal theorem or an authoritative status.
